notes.periods: Keys are scoring periods. 1-16 are weekly (17 also for 2021-2023, the only seasons with a week 17). 18 is the season total / final roster.
notes.scores: projectedScore and actualScore are per player. In period 18 they are full-season totals. null means not available.
notes.startersTotal: Sum of the listed starters' scores for that period.
notes.dataAvailability: 2018-2023 'full': starters, bench and IR with projected and actual scores each week. 2010-2017 'starters_actual_only': ESPN did not keep weekly bench or projections, so weekly periods hold starters only with projectedScore and slot null; period 18 is the final roster with season totals.
notes.oldSeasonFields: matchupTotalPoints is ESPN's official weekly team score (2010-2017). incompleteLineup means the listed starters do not add up to it (a starter missing from ESPN data, mostly 2010-2011). noMatchupScore means no scored matchup that week.
notes.owners: ownerName normalized by hand. Team 5: Alex Teves 2010-2011, Tommy Teves 2012-2021, Tommy Teves & Nick Heisterkamp (coOwners) 2022-2023. Team 10: Nic Ferrara 2011-2023. Team 3 2015: Garrett Clatanoff. Team 2: David Morris. Team 1: Clint Helling.
notes.omitted: PRK, AVG and LAST were not captured; AVG can be computed from the scores.
